title: Annual Report
summary: The ECB's 2024 Annual Report landing page summarizes key monetary policy actions and economic outcomes for the year. Headline inflation declined to 2.4% in December 2024 from 2.9% in December 2023, moving closer to the 2% target. The ECB cut interest rates four times during 2024, reducing the deposit facility rate to 3.00% with a cumulative decrease of 100 basis points.
key_points: Headline inflation declined to 2.4% in December 2024 from 2.9% in December 2023, moving closer to the 2% target
ECB cut interest rates four times in 2024
Deposit facility rate was brought to 3.00%
Cumulative rate decrease over 2024 was 100 basis points
Luis de Guindos presented the report to the European Parliament's Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs
why_it_matters: This annual report provides an official summary of ECB monetary policy actions and economic assessment for 2024. The 100 bps cumulative rate cut and decline in inflation toward target confirm the ECB's easing cycle and validate that inflation was under control. Market participants tracking ECB policy normalization can reference these figures as anchors for the 2024 policy backdrop.
macro_context: The 2.4% headline inflation print in December 2024 confirms that price pressures had moderated significantly from the 2.9% level a year prior. The four rate cuts totaling 100 bps demonstrate the ECB's commitment to easing monetary conditions as inflation approached target. The deposit facility rate at 3.00% provides the reference point for ECB policy normalization progress.
